content:
**The Whitespring Grounds** are several locations surrounding the Whitespring Resort in *Fallout 76*.

The expansive exterior grounds of the Whitespring are comprised of several pre-War amenities, housing, shops, and maintenance facilities. [1] The Springhill Golf Course serves as the perimeter and is bordered by Highway 62 to the east, State Route 83A/Golf Road to the south, and the New Appalachian Central Trainyard to the north. A mountainous region dividing The Forest from Savage Divide is directly to the west.
